target.title: [AI-assisted] feat(android): add chat command controls
target.body:
﻿## What Problem This Solves

Android chat users currently do not have an obvious first-class control for starting a fresh chat/session or discovering available slash commands from the composer. That makes common chat actions harder to find on the Android app and leaves command discovery dependent on knowing the text commands ahead of time.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds Android chat controls for new-chat/session reset and slash-command discovery while keeping command execution semantics on the existing Gateway boundary. The composer command picker is backed by Gateway-advertised command metadata and keeps filtering predictable by matching command names and aliases, not descriptions or categories.

This PR intentionally does not change Gateway command execution, model routing, provider behavior, permissions, dependencies, or workflows.

## User Impact

Android users get visible chat controls for starting a new chat and selecting slash commands from the composer. Slash suggestions are narrower and more predictable: `/` lists available commands, prefixes such as `/mo` and `/de` match command names or aliases, and unrelated description/category text does not create noisy matches.

## Evidence

Focused Android command-control tests passed:

```text
./gradlew :app:testPlayDebugUnitTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.ui.chat.ChatCommandControlsTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.chat.ChatControllerCommandControlsTest --console=plain --stacktrace
BUILD SUCCESSFUL
```

Full Android Play debug unit tests passed:

```text
./gradlew :app:testPlayDebugUnitTest --console=plain --stacktrace
BUILD SUCCESSFUL
```

Play debug APK build passed:

```text
./gradlew :app:assemblePlayDebug --console=plain --stacktrace
BUILD SUCCESSFUL
```

Emulator smoke verification installed and launched the Play debug APK as `ai.openclaw.app`.

What the tests cover:

- Slash command filtering for `/`, `/n`, `/mo`, and `/de`.
- Alias-based matching such as `/delegate` for the agent command path.
- No matches through description/category text for queries such as `/runtime` or `/session`.
- Local `/new` and `/reset` handling for the new-chat/session-reset path.

Remaining proof gap:

- A connected Android chat UI session with redacted screenshots or recording of the new-chat control, slash-command picker, and `/new` or `/reset` flow has not been completed yet.
- The emulator smoke reached app launch, but it did not produce PR-ready visual proof of the connected chat composer controls.
